product.title: Custom Velcro Hat Patches
product.descriptionHtml:
Velcro Hat Patches are designed to offer the classic elegance and texture of direct embroidery alongside the versatility of removable placement. These patches blend the detail of fine embroidery with the convenience of Velcro backing, making it easy to attach and remove from hats or accessories. Choose from a sleek, thin-stitched edge for seamless integration or a sturdy Merrow border for added resilience.

Each patch order includes a Free roll of Thermal Tape.
